segments.contextAfter: `baseInstance`: The lowest value the command passes to your vertex shader’s parameter with the `instance_id` attribute. The command assigns each drawing instance a unique `instance_id` value that increases from `baseInstance` through `(baseInstance + instanceCount - 1)`. Your shader can use that value to identify which instance the vertex belongs to. For more information about the `instance_id` argument attribute for vertex shaders, see the [`Metal Shading Language Specification (PDF)`](https://developer.apple.comhttps://developer.apple.com/metal/Metal-Shading-Language-Specification.pdf).
